packages.title: Employee offboarding
packages.summary: A manager submits a leaver; access is revoked on the right day, equipment recovered, final pay scheduled, the exit interview held and the termination recorded.

packages.title: Employee onboarding
packages.summary: HR enters a new hire; the HR record, laptop, accounts, buddy and first-week plan are all arranged before day one, with a 30-day check-in.

packages.title: Equipment request
packages.summary: Employees request kit from an equipment catalogue; a cost and role policy routes approval, IT fulfils the request and the asset is registered.

packages.title: Leave request
packages.summary: Employees request leave from a form; the balance, leave-type rules and an approval policy decide auto-approval, manager or HR review, then the leave is booked.

packages.title: Probation review
packages.summary: Every morning, employees whose probation ends within three weeks get a manager review; the outcome is confirmed, extended or ended and recorded.

packages.title: Timesheet approval
packages.summary: A weekly timesheet form with Mon–Fri hours and a project lookup; totals and overtime are calculated, approvers approve or reject, and long weeks get a second check.

packages.title: Training sign-off
packages.summary: Trainees submit course completion evidence on a form; their trainer signs it off or asks for more, and the training record and expiry date are kept.

packages.title: Workday new hire → onboarding
packages.summary: A Workday Hire event reads the worker, applies the job family checklist and onboarding plan, starts IT provisioning and has the hiring manager prepare day one.

packages.title: Workday time-off request sync
packages.summary: Every 30 minutes, time off requests from a Workday report sync to a Team calendar table; long or critical absences get a manager cover check.

packages.title: Workday worker change → access update
packages.summary: A Workday job change, org move or termination maps old and new jobs to access bundles, logs the request, and the manager approves or rejects it.

packages.title: Expense claims
packages.summary: Employees submit a claim from a form; category limits and an approval policy route it, and approved claims are queued for reimbursement.

packages.title: Invoice three-way match
packages.summary: Match each incoming invoice to its purchase order and goods receipts, pay matches within tolerance and route exceptions to accounts payable.

packages.title: Month-end close checklist
packages.summary: On the first of each month, open the close in the ERP and issue every checklist task with a deadline, evidence rule and an audit log.

packages.title: NetSuite vendor bill (AP) approval
packages.summary: NetSuite posts a vendor bill; subsidiary and amount limits pick the approvers, AP codes the cost centre and approves, rejects or holds, and NetSuite is updated.

packages.title: Petty cash claims
packages.summary: A themed petty cash claim form with a cost-centre lookup and receipt link, float and limit rules, budget-holder approval and a ledger.

packages.title: Purchase requisition to PO
packages.summary: Requesters submit a requisition; the purchasing policy sets approvals and quotes, and approved requests become a purchase order sent to the supplier.

packages.title: SAP purchase requisition → PO approval
packages.summary: An SAP S/4HANA purchase requisition is read over OData, routed by an approval matrix to approvers who pick the cost centre, then turned into a PO.

packages.title: SAP supplier invoice posting with 3-way match
packages.summary: A captured supplier invoice is matched to the SAP PO and goods receipts; variances outside tolerance go to AP, and matched invoices are posted to S/4HANA.

packages.title: SAP vendor master change approval
packages.summary: A themed form requests a supplier bank change; SAP data is compared, finance reviews, the supplier is called back, treasury approves and SAP is updated.

packages.title: Vendor onboarding with KYC
packages.summary: Screen new vendors for sanctions, registry and adverse media, tier the risk, review and verify bank details, then create the vendor in the ERP.

packages.title: Access request and provisioning
packages.summary: People request application access from a form; risk-based approvals route it, the grant is provisioned automatically and time-boxed access is revoked on expiry.

packages.title: Change management with CAB
packages.summary: An RFC form scores change risk, routes to pre-approval, CAB or emergency CAB, then tracks implementation and the post-implementation review in your ITSM.

packages.title: Incident triage
packages.summary: Monitoring alerts open prioritised ITSM incidents automatically; repeat alerts are deduplicated and P1/P2 incidents page the on-call engineer with escalation.

packages.title: IT equipment loans
packages.summary: Staff borrow laptops, phones and headsets from a loan pool: manager approval, availability tracking, a return check with reminders and a full loan log.

packages.title: Joiner, mover, leaver sync
packages.summary: A nightly job reads joiners, movers and leavers from the HR system and creates, updates or disables directory accounts with role-based groups, logging every action.

packages.title: Microsoft 365 / Entra account provisioning
packages.summary: A themed IT form requests a new starter account; the manager approves, then Graph creates the Entra user, assigns the licence and adds the department group.

packages.title: Security alert enrichment
packages.summary: SIEM alerts are enriched with IP reputation, user and asset context, then auto-closed, opened as a SOAR case, or contained after analyst approval.

packages.title: ServiceNow change approval
packages.summary: ServiceNow sends a change for approval; CI criticality and a risk table route it, the CAB approves, rejects or asks for info, and the approval is written back.

packages.title: ServiceNow major incident review
packages.summary: ServiceNow posts a new or escalated incident; the criteria table flags major incident candidates and the incident manager declares major or not.

packages.title: Complaint handling with SLAs
packages.summary: Agents log a complaint; the customer tier and an SLA matrix set response and resolution targets, with escalation, compensation approval and CRM case resolution.

packages.title: Complaints tracker
packages.summary: Log complaints against a simple customer CRM; tier and category set the priority and SLA, the customer is acknowledged and handlers resolve or escalate.

packages.title: Customer onboarding with KYC
packages.summary: Account managers register a new business customer; KYC screening, a credit report and a risk rating set the tier and limit before the account is opened.

packages.title: Event registration
packages.summary: A themed registration form with an event lookup, capacity check and waitlist, confirmation emails and an organiser task for special requests.

packages.title: Lead routing and enrichment
packages.summary: Enrich each inbound lead, score it with a routing table, create it in the CRM with its territory owner, and alert sales or start nurture.

packages.title: Quote approval with discount tiers
packages.summary: Sales reps submit a quote; a discount authority table sets who approves, and each approver can approve, reject or counter before the CPQ is updated.

packages.title: Salesforce opportunity discount approval
packages.summary: A Salesforce Flow submits an opportunity discount; tiers decide the approvers, the sales manager then finance approve, and the status goes back to Salesforce.

packages.title: Audit evidence collection
packages.summary: Monthly SOC 2 / ISO 27001 evidence run: automated controls are pulled from your systems, owners of manual controls are asked for a link, all logged for the auditor.

packages.title: Contract renewal reminders
packages.summary: A daily check of your contract register: owners are reminded 60, 30 and 7 days before each notice deadline and asked to renew, renegotiate or terminate.

packages.title: GDPR data subject requests
packages.summary: Handle access, erasure and other privacy requests: statutory deadline, identity check, search of CRM, billing and support, erasure, and a DPO-approved reply.

packages.title: Inventory reorder
packages.summary: A daily stock check finds items at or below their reorder point, raises an Approve order / Skip task for each and emails the supplier a purchase order.

packages.title: Policy acknowledgement tracker
packages.summary: Every week, issue the current policy to every active person, track who has acknowledged it, remind the rest and give the policy owner one chase list.

packages.title: Policy attestation
packages.summary: A monthly campaign: employees confirm they have read the policies due for them, with reminders, escalation to compliance and an audit trail of attestations.

packages.title: Risk register
packages.summary: Anyone raises a risk on a form; a 5×5 matrix rates it, the owner accepts, mitigates or escalates within an SLA, and a weekly job re-reviews due risks.

packages.title: Safety inspection checklist
packages.summary: Every month, a safety inspection checklist task for each site with Pass / Fail buttons; failures raise a corrective action and are logged.

packages.title: Supplier risk review
packages.summary: Adding a supplier or flagging it for review pulls a fresh risk rating, sets the tier and next review date, and sends high-risk suppliers to procurement.

packages.title: Workplace incident log
packages.summary: A safety-themed incident form, severity and SLA from a decision table, an incident register with 7-year retention and an investigation task with Close / Escalate.

packages.title: Asset register & check-out
packages.summary: A register of loanable equipment with a check-out form, a due-back return task with a reminder, and Returned / Damaged outcomes that update the register.

packages.title: Car-pool & fleet booking
packages.summary: Book a pool car on a themed form: service and clash checks, a decision table for long, multi-day or weekend trips, coordinator approval and a confirmation email.

packages.title: Meeting room booking
packages.summary: Book a room from a themed start form; rules send large, long or catered bookings to facilities for approval, everything else is confirmed straight away.

packages.title: Visitor sign-in
packages.summary: A themed reception form signs visitors in, looks up their host, logs the visit, emails the host and has reception confirm an NDA when needed.

packages.title: AI ticket triage with human review
packages.summary: An AI agent classifies each helpdesk ticket and drafts a reply; confident, low-risk answers go out automatically and the rest wait for a person.

packages.title: Document generation pipeline
packages.summary: Turn contract data from any app into a filled Word contract and Excel fee schedule, file both in your DMS and send the contract for e-signature.

packages.title: Event-driven ETL
packages.summary: Each new row in an Orders staging table is normalised, converted to the base currency, loaded into the warehouse and marked loaded or failed.

packages.title: Order orchestration API
packages.summary: A synchronous order endpoint for your storefront: validate, price, fraud-screen, reserve stock, authorise payment and create the shipment in one call.

packages.title: Scheduled data reconciliation
packages.summary: Every morning, yesterday's orders are matched to billing invoices; missing invoices and amount mismatches are recorded and a summary is sent.

packages.title: Webhook multi-system sync
packages.summary: A CRM "account updated" webhook is validated and fanned out to the ERP, billing platform and support desk, with every result written to a sync log.
